title: Two finite coefficient factorizations for the open exceptional counit
statement: Under the hypotheses and notation of [lem-coef-open-scalar-adjunction-counit], the two finite coefficient packages for E and L both satisfy CoefficientFactored, including their origin, exactness, finite-Tor, and counit clauses.

source.place: Proof paragraph 3, steps 1–3: finite coefficient domains and locally closed exceptional factorization.

proof.text: Apply finite-type Noetherianity, exact closed direct image, open extension, compact-support composition, and the bounded flat-model preservation theorem separately to the E and L coefficient rings; the resulting data are exactly the two CoefficientFactored packages in the statement.
